rows.text: returns at once when `cx` is -1; otherwise forms the record `qword [022C6F28] + cx*0x740` (`cx` sign-extended), calls the function pointer `rdx` with (that record, `r8`), and when word `+8` of the record is not -1 calls `0042EF90(that word, rdx, r8)`

returns when word `+0x2F2` of `rcx` is 1; otherwise takes the signed word at qword `[rdx+8]` as the id, replaced by word `+6` of `rcx` when that is not -1, and when `003E5CF0` returns 0x1C or more (signed) takes the pointer `qword [022C6F28] + id*0x740` (0 when the id is -1 or when that record's dword `+0x284` is 0, and word `+6` is still read through it) and replaces the id with that word `+6` when it is not -1; then calls `0042F310(word [rcx], id zero-extended from 16 bits, 0x10A)`

indexes 64-byte entries of `02CA6CA0` by the low byte of `edx`; when that entry's dword `+4` equals `edx` it stores `edx - 1` to the entry's dword `+0xC` and returns that value, otherwise it returns 0
